FAQ

For paper packaging converters FAQ

Can we test our exact paper specification?

Yes. A 200 m sample length can be provided in any requested specification after construction, width and shipment details are confirmed.

Is a report enough to approve production?

No. Review the report scope and run the actual converting and finished-product checks required by your process and market.

How is MOQ handled?

MOQ generally starts at 5 tonnes for coated base paper. The confirmed quantity depends on the selected grade, customization, packaging and order structure and is stated in the written quotation. Lead time depends on the order quantity and production schedule. It is confirmed in the written quotation rather than published as a fixed number of days.
